inputs.original_text: Eight million Americans join anti-Trump protests across US, organisers say An estimated 8 million people gathered at more than 3,300 events across all 50 US states, organisers of the “No Kings” protests said, as demonstrators voiced opposition to President Donald Trump’s leadership. News agency AFP reported that the events were held nationwide, though US authorities have not provided an official count. Organisers said turnout surpassed earlier demonstrations, noting there were “about one million more participants and 600 more events compared to the last No Kings demonstrations in October.”
inputs.modified_text: So they're pushing this line that an estimated 8 million Americans showed up at more than 3,300 events across all 50 states for these "No Kings" protests against President Donald Trump. Organizers claim it beat their last round in October by about one million more participants and 600 more events. AFP is repeating it like it's fact, yet US authorities gave no official count at all. This reeks of coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions trying to manufacture the appearance of massive opposition and keep their control intact. The lack of real verification just confirms it's another narrative play to weaken his leadership, not some organic wave of dissent.
